commitments.claim: FY26 hyperscaler AI infrastructure orders raised to ~$9B (from $5B) with $5.3B taken through Q3, and FY26 AI revenue raised to ~$4B (from $3B)
Fiscal 2026 Plan: up to $1B pre-tax restructuring charges — ~$450M in Q4 FY26, remainder during FY27, plan substantially complete by end of FY27 — to fund silicon, optics, security and AI investment
Major multi-year, multi-billion-dollar campus networking refresh underway; campus orders +25% y/y and data center switching orders +40% y/y in Q3 FY26

Quarterly dividend of $0.42 per share declared May 13, 2026 (paid July 22, 2026), continuing the pattern of annual dividend increases; ~$9.6B remains on the repurchase authorization with no termination date
Supply chain secured for the AI ramp: inventory purchase commitments doubled to $16.0B at April 25, 2026 from $7.6B at July 26, 2025

buy_triggers.marker: Q4 FY26 print (Aug 2026 8-K): revenue ≥ $16.9B (above guidance high end) with product orders still growing double digits ex-hyperscalers — confirms the campus refresh plus AI ramp is durable
FY27 guidance issued at this release implying non-GAAP EPS growth ≥ 8% (~$4.63+) despite the ~$550M FY27 restructuring drag — signals operating leverage from the Fiscal 2026 Plan
Hyperscaler AI orders for FY26 at or above the raised $9B target, or a FY27 target above ~$14B, disclosed on the call/press release
Networking revenue growth reaccelerating to ≥ +20% y/y in FY27 Q1 (ended October 2026) as AI orders convert to revenue
Quarterly CFO recovering to ≥ $4.5B (FCF ≥ $4B) by FY27 Q2 after the FY26 tax and inventory drags annualize

sell_triggers.marker: Q4 FY26 revenue below the $16.7B guidance low end, or product order growth decelerating to low-single-digits y/y, indicating the Q3 order spike was pull-forward
FY27 Q1 non-GAAP gross margin guided or printed below ~64.5% — evidence that hyperscaler mix, memory costs and tariffs are structurally eroding margin
sell_triggers.checkable_at: Q4 FY26 8-K (guidance) and FY27 Q1 8-K, November 2026

sell_triggers.marker: Security revenue declining y/y again in FY27 H1 — Splunk integration failing to reignite the second-largest product category

thesis.what_must_be_true: CSCO's double-digit FY26 momentum is a real demand cycle, not pull-forward: (1) the $9B FY26 hyperscaler AI order book converts to revenue through FY27 with $16B of purchase commitments already securing supply; (2) the campus refresh sustains Networking growth in the teens even as AI mix, memory costs and tariffs cap gross margin near 62-63% GAAP / ~66% non-GAAP; (3) the Fiscal 2026 Plan ($1B total, ~$550M in FY27) funds silicon/optics/security/AI reinvestment while non-GAAP operating margin holds ~34-35%, letting non-GAAP EPS compound at high single digits; (4) working capital normalizes after the FY26 inventory build and final transition-tax payment, restoring FCF toward ~$16B+ in FY27 to fund the dividend and the $9.6B remaining buyback authorization.

validated.preview_note: CSCO reports FQ4'26 (Jul 25 quarter) Wednesday with a rare setup: momentum has never been stronger — product orders +35% y/y in FQ3, networking orders +50%, hyperscaler AI orders raised twice to $9B — yet GAAP optics are muddy. Management guided revenue $16.7-16.9B and non-GAAP EPS $1.16-1.18, both of which embed the $450M restructuring charge (GAAP EPS guide $0.80-0.85) and estimated tariff impact. We model $16.8B and $1.19, with GAAP EPS of $0.90 as a negative other-income swing masks underlying margin strength. Three things decide the reaction: (1) whether hyperscaler AI orders print near ~$3.7B for the quarter (needed to hit the $9B) and whether FQ4 AI revenue lands near the implied ~$1.5B; (2) non-GAAP gross margin vs the 65.5-66.5% guide — memory costs and AI mix are the swing factor; (3) FY27 guidance — we expect ~$67-68B revenue and ~$4.60-4.65 non-GAAP EPS for the year with FQ1 guided at $16.4-16.8B / $1.10-1.14. Watch CFO conversion after the FY26 tax/inventory drags. An in-line print with strong AI orders and a credible FY27 guide beats a beat-and-lower-quality guide.
validated.reasoning: Anchors are filed facts: Q3 FY26 revenue $15,841M, GAAP EPS $0.85, non-GAAP EPS $1.06, CFO $3,757M; guidance $16.7-16.9B / $1.16-1.18 non-GAAP EPS with ~$450M restructuring inside GAAP. Q4 build: revenue $16,800M (+12% y/y, seasonally the year's largest quarter, and consistent with orders +35%, campus refresh and the $16B purchase-commitment wall — I place the median at guidance midpoint rather than above because Q3's order surge includes pull-forward ahead of tariffs/price increases). GAAP gross margin 62.5% (guidance bridge 63.5-64.5% midpoint minus tariff and AI-mix slippage at the lower bound). Opex up modestly (R&D $2,400M, S&M $2,950M, G&A $660M); intangible amortization steps down to $215M per the 10-Q's remaining-FY26 schedule ($447M total, split COGS/opex). Restructuring $450M exactly as disclosed. GAAP operating income $3,825M (22.8% margin, inside the 23-24% guide). Non-GAAP operating margin 34.5%. Below the line I model a negative other-income swing (-$90M) after Q3's +$242M venture-mark windfall; interest income declines on lower cash. GAAP tax is a small benefit (-$24M): restructuring geographic mix, stock-comp windfalls and the guided ~16% rate applied to a lower non-GAAP-adjusted base. GAAP EPS $0.90 — above the $0.80-0.85 guide, which carries the usual Cisco conservatism on tax and other income. Non-GAAP net income $4,693M = $1.19/share, a penny above guidance top, consistent with the company's recent pattern of landing at/above the high end. Cash flow: CFO $4,300M (Q4 seasonally strongest; FY25 Q4 $4.2B; no transition-tax payment, but restructuring severance begins and inventory stays elevated), capex $550M (FY26 ~$1.57B total, step-up for AI/silicon capacity), buybacks $1,850M and dividends $1,650M ($0.42 paid July 22), CP/debt roughly flat in other_financing, FX -$20M. Net change in cash = 4,300 - 550 - 3,650 - 20 = +$80M, rolling cash to $7,163M; retained earnings roll to $783M ($704M + $3,579M NI - $1,650M dividends - $1,850M buybacks); total assets $124,443M, liabilities the residual $75,430M, equity $49,013M. FY26 totals: revenue $62,873M (above the $63.0B guide top on a rounding basis — guidance midpoints), non-GAAP EPS $4.30, FCF ~$13.3B. FY27: revenue $67.9B (+8%) as the $9B AI order book converts and campus refresh persists, partly offset by tougher comps; EPS $4.63 (+8%) with ~$550M FY27 restructuring charges excluded from non-GAAP but depressing GAAP margins (quarterly_path GAAP operating margins 24.5-26.2% reflect H1-weighted charges); capex $1.8B and FCF $16.4B as the tax tailwind (FY26's $2.3B transition payment annualizes) and working-capital normalization restore conversion. FY28/FY29 growth decays toward 5-7% revenue with EPS compounding ~9% on buybacks. FY27 Q1 guidance forecast: $16.4-16.8B revenue and $1.10-1.14 non-GAAP EPS — normal seasonality (Q1 below Q4) with restructuring noise handled in the GAAP-to-non-GAAP bridge.
